args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity,
unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). Affected
versions are <2.9.4; 2.9.4 is the fix release on the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337.

## Details
- CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays.
- Affected versions: <2.9.4, >=3.0.0 <3.1.0. Fixed in 2.9.4 (and 3.1.0).
- We stay on the 2.x line and bump to 2.9.4, the fix release.

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 on commit c8b8ab7878: **passed**.

## Review
Requesting review from @alex (code owner).
